meta.title: Antaclis · Seeing through fields
meta.description: Antaclis builds AI for magnetic sensing: physics simulation and machine learning that turn what a sensor reads into the properties of what produced it. Sensor, simulation and inference, built as one system.
meta.image_alt: Antaclis logo and the words 'Seeing through fields.' next to magnetic field lines.

hero.title: Seeing through fields.
hero.lead: AI for inverse problems in magnetic sensing. We simulate the physics, learn from it, and turn what a sensor reads into what produced it.

measure.title: Measure.
measure.text: A quantum magnetometer scans the magnetic field in the room.

infer.title: Infer.
infer.text: Simulation-based AI traces the data back to the sources of the field and characterises them: where they are, how strong, what they are made of.

landing.title: That is Antaclis.
landing.text: Custom AI for your problems, informed by physics.

work.title: What we do
work.statement: You build the system, we take the measurements. Sensor, simulation and machine learning, built together, turn them into the insight you need.

topics.title: Magnetic sensors
topics.text: Quantum and classical magnetometers, built or adapted for the problem and modelled down to their instrumental limits.

topics.title: Physics simulation
topics.text: Differentiable simulations of fields, sources and sensors, written to feed our machine learning directly.

topics.title: Machine learning
topics.text: Simulation-based inference: models trained on our simulations and calibrated against real measurements, closing the gap between theory and the lab.

topics.title: Inverse problems
topics.text: From readings back to the physical properties that generated them, with Bayesian uncertainties and confidence levels rather than a single best guess.
